findings.title: parseBody breaks after c.req.formData() already consumed body
findings.why_it_matters: Apps where a middleware (or the handler) calls `c.req.formData()` before `c.req.parseBody()` used to get the cached FormData back; now they break. Multipart requests throw `TypeError: Failed to parse body as FormData` (500), and urlencoded requests silently return garbage keys (the multipart serialization of the cached FormData parsed as urlencoded). The cause is that parseFormData always calls `request.arrayBuffer()`. With only `bodyCache.formData` present, HonoRequest's #cachedBody rebuilds the buffer via `new Response(formData).arrayBuffer()`, which re-serializes as multipart with a freshly generated boundary. That buffer is then parsed against the original Content-Type header (original boundary, or urlencoded). Reusing an existing `bodyCache.formData` before falling back to the arrayBuffer path, as validator.ts:115-116 already does, restores the old behavior and keeps the mixed-case fix.
findings.suggested_fix: In parseFormData, before reading the arrayBuffer: `if (request instanceof HonoRequest && request.bodyCache.formData) { const formData = await request.bodyCache.formData; return convertFormDataToBodyData<T>(formData, options) }` (same guard as validator.ts:115), then keep the arrayBuffer + bufferToFormData path for the uncached case. Add a regression test in src/request.test.ts or body.test.ts: a middleware calls `await c.req.formData()`, then the handler's `c.req.parseBody()` returns `{ foo: 'bar' }` for both multipart and urlencoded bodies.
evidence: src/utils/body.ts:143 -- const arrayBuffer = await (request as Request).arrayBuffer()
src/request.ts:228-234 -- const anyCachedKey = Object.keys(bodyCache)[0] ... return new Response(body)[key]()  (a cached FormData is re-serialized with a new multipart boundary)
src/utils/body.ts:144 -- bufferToFormData(arrayBuffer, headers.get('Content-Type') || '')  (parsed against the original header's boundary/media type)

Probe at HEAD (middleware `await c.req.formData()`, then handler `c.req.parseBody()`): multipart -> 500 'TypeError: Failed to parse body as FormData.'; urlencoded -> 200 {"------formdata-undici-...Content-Disposition: form-data; name":"\"foo\"..."}
The same probe against base 9728702: multipart -> 200 {"foo":"bar"}; urlencoded -> 200 {"foo":"bar"}
src/validator/validator.ts:115-116 -- if (c.req.bodyCache.formData) { formData = await c.req.bodyCache.formData  (existing reuse pattern)

residual_risks: parseBody no longer calls `request.formData()` at all (the removed vi.spyOn(req, 'formData') mock in body.test.ts shows this). Runtime adapters or user code that override or wrap Request.formData() are now bypassed, and multipart uploads are buffered in full into an ArrayBuffer that stays in bodyCache for the request's lifetime, instead of being parsed natively. This is an observable behavior change the PR description does not mention.
testing_gaps: No test covers the formData()-then-parseBody() ordering on a HonoRequest, which is exactly the path this diff regressed.
